clusters.description: Abdelaziz on the Pound 4 Pound podcast: Usman Nurmagomedov would beat the whole UFC lightweight roster, wants Topuria as his first UFC fight and says Usman would make him quit; only Tsarukyan is a real challenge
clusters.doubt: #78 (ABC) frames it around Makhachev's manager and the old Topuria-Makhachev feud, but the news is the same podcast remarks.

clusters.description: Kawa (Topuria's manager) fires back at Abdelaziz in a social media video: Topuria 'would annihilate 100% of your roster', would beat Gaethje in a rematch, had a bad night, is still No. 1
clusters.doubt: #102/#97 (MARCA) put Abdelaziz's quote in the headline and retell both sides, but the hook is Kawa's response; #55 is Yahoo's syndication of #51.

clusters.description: Abdelaziz tells MMA Junkie that Gaethje is not retiring, will fight in 2027 and only wants a massive fight
clusters.doubt: Same manager and same week as 02-a, but a different interview (MMA Junkie, not the podcast) about a different client.

clusters.description: ABC lifestyle feature on Topuria's favourite restaurant in Spain (Nou Collonet on Tabarca island)
McGregor posts his first message after knee surgery (ACL/meniscus from UFC 329) - about someone else, Topuria not involved
Topuria's Instagram statement after losing to Gaethje: praises Gaethje, no excuses, reveals vision loss in both eyes, plans to heal and pursue a rematch
clusters.doubt: Dated Aug 8 but describes the June fight as 'on Sunday' and calls it his first statement, so it may be a stale or re-published piece; the fight result itself is not in this batch.

clusters.description: Ian Machado Garry says Khabib is one of the greatest despite retiring early - about someone else, Topuria only appears in a 'latest news' link
Leon's FID sports forum announces Carolina Marin, Carlos Moya and Aldo Martinez (Topuria's performance doctor) as speakers
clusters.doubt: Two identical copies of the same article; about Topuria's doctor rather than Topuria.

clusters.description: mma.es generic UFC rankings update page (11 August)
Kawa calls for an immediate Gaethje rematch in a social media post, after meeting Topuria in Miami as he recovers from facial injuries
clusters.doubt: The text cuts off at 'en una publicacion de redes so...', so I cannot tell if this is the same Kawa video as 02-b (which mentions a Gaethje rematch) or a separate post; the framing (immediate rematch, Miami meeting, recovery) reads like a new post.

clusters.description: Makhachev on Demetrious Johnson's MightyCast: Topuria lost focus, underestimated Gaethje, celebrated the night before, but can be champion again if he refocuses

uncertain_pairs.why: Both are Kawa social media posts mentioning a Gaethje rematch within two days of each other; #129 could be ABC's reading of the same video rather than a new post.
MARCA's headline quotes Abdelaziz ('Usman would make Topuria submit') and half the body is his podcast remarks, so it could be filed under the Abdelaziz story instead of Kawa's response.
Same manager talking about his clients in the same week; if the MMA Junkie interview and the podcast were the same appearance, these would be one story.
